label: Product sampling laws on one plenitude roster leave the report probability unidentified (inference)
rule: Evaluate Bernoulli-geometric product measures and apply the identifiability criterion
meaning: The roster Bool x Nat repeats each type through an injection from Nat. For interior p the product of a Bernoulli(p) report law and a geometric(1/2) index law is a probability with positive point masses and true-fiber mass p. Rates 1/100 and 99/100 share all scope data but differ in that mass, so the scope data do not identify it.
